title: Pani Na Mango Hussain
body:
HUSSAIN (a.s.) ghareeb Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
Katoo'nga sukha gala ..(2)
pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Phero na sukhi zaba'n honto'n pa shahe zama'n ..(2)
Rehm nahi khaoo'ga,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Main hun mutee e yazeed pyasa karoo'nga shaheed ..(2)
Roeyen to kya fathima s.a,,, pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mangu jo kousar ka jaam do na mujhe ya imam ..(2)
Ya'n to hai qabza mera,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pooche'n jo aa Mustafa s.a.w doo'nga na mein mutlaqa ..(2)
Kuch nahi khoufe khuda,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hote agar murtaza pyaas bujhete wo aah ..(2)
Mein to nahi dene ka,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ab na karo kuch sawal aa gaya waqte zawal ..(2)
Khoon piyo halq ka,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bait ke seene pa aah kehta tha wo roo siyah..(2)
Jane rasoole khuda,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kya likhoo'n HAMID wo haal kehta tha wo bad qisal ..(2)
Katoo'nga sukha gala,,,pani na mango Hussain (a.s.)
Shimr ne sheh se kaha pani na mango Hussain (a.s.) ..(2)
